moment.title: Pauly B, You are an All-Star
Keep It In Stride
moment.description: Silver Strider, aka Spencer Strider, continued in stride from his 2022 campaign, with nine strikeouts in each of his first three starts in 2023. Pitching with Strider, tally five strikeouts in one contest.

moment.title: The Doctor Will See You Now
moment.description: Doc Halladay, aka Roy Halladay, was slinging pitches to each and every corner with ease during his elite tenure on the mound. Pitching with Halladay, throw three innings of scoreless work.

moment.title: Rocky Road
moment.description: Rock, aka Tim Raines, brought muscle and speed to the ballpark, as he led the National League in stolen bases from 1981-1984. Playing as Raines, steal one base.

moment.title: Konerko Crushes Home Runs
moment.description: At the 2002 Home Run Derby, Paul Konerko crushed 12 total home runs, paving his way to the semi-finals. Batting as Konerko, hit one home run in one game.

moment.title: The Scherzer All-Star Era Begins
moment.description: In his All-Star Game debut, Max Scherzer tossed a perfect 1st inning, retiring all three batters that he faced. Pitch one inning with Scherzer and tally one strikeout without allowing a run, hit, or walk.

moment.title: Salvy Slam for the Lead
moment.description: In his fourth All-Star Game appearance in 2016, Salvador Perez blasted a 2-run HR in the 2nd inning to give the American League a 3-1 lead. Batting as Perez, tally four total bases in one game.

moment.title: Hunter Homers at the Derby
moment.description: In the first half of the 2002 season, Torii Hunter tallied 20 home runs, earning a selection to the Home Run Derby. Batting as Hunter, tally one extra-base hit in one game.

moment.title: The Rookie Shines at the All-Star Game
Dee-molishing the Competition
moment.description: During Dee Strange-Gordon's 2015 All-Star season, he led MLB in hits (205) and stolen bases (58). Playing as Gordon, get on base two times in one game.

moment.title: Syndergaard's Sensational Arm
moment.description: In 2016, Noah Syndergaard was selected to his first All-Star Game, after posting a 2.56 ERA with 128 strikeouts in the first half. Pitching as Syndergaard, pitch one inning and tally three strikeouts.

moment.title: KB Goes Kaboom
moment.description: During his rookie season in 2015, Kris Bryant was selected to participate in the Home Run Derby, where he blasted nine home runs in the first round. Batting as Bryant, tally one home run in one game.

moment.title: Winker's Wonderful First Half
moment.description: Jesse Winker was selected to his first All-Star Game in 2021 after accumulating a .301 batting average, 19 home runs, and a 0.922 OPS in the first half. Batting as Winker, tally six total bases in one game.

moment.title: Aguilar Annihilates Baseballs
moment.description: After slugging 24 home runs in the first half of the 2018 season, Jesus Aguilar participated in the Home Run Derby, where he hit 12 home runs in the first round. Batting as Aguilar, hit one home run in one game.

moment.title: Ludwick Leads His Way to the All-Star Game
moment.description: Ryan Ludwick had a breakout season in 2008, where he had career-highs in HR (37) and RBI (113), while also being selected to his first All-Star Game as a part of the the National League squad. Playing as Ludwick, get on base two times.
